Q9033.reason: Vienna Convention Art. 31 combines good faith, ordinary meaning in context, and object and purpose; the team note wrongly makes object and purpose the sole criterion.

Q9036.reason: A keloid is a firm, raised scar mass that grows beyond the original wound edges; the team note describes the opposite (a flat, narrow scar).

Q9037.reason: Tracheostomy is most commonly used to wean patients off prolonged mechanical ventilation; the team note wrongly says it restores vocal cord movement.
